references.text: This verse in Judges repeats almost verbatim the content of Joshua 24:31 and describes how Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the elders who outlived him.
Describes how Israel feared the Lord and trusted in Him after the great works He performed through Moses, a similar theme about knowing the Lord's deeds.
Moses exhorts the people to remember the Lord's deeds that He did for Israel, the same theme mentioned in Joshua 24:31.
Describes the next generation as not knowing the Lord or His works for Israel, in contrast to the generation mentioned in Joshua 24:31.
The immediate context describing Joshua's death, which sets the framework for the verse about Israel's service under his leadership.
Speaks of proclaiming the Lord's deeds to the next generation so that they will put their trust in God and not forget His works.
